verdict.rationale: Evidence covers WinUI/Windows App SDK, Store submission, and general OS features like Snap layouts, Copilot, Windows Hello, but nothing addresses developer toolchains, IDE support, or AI/ML software stacks (e.g., VS Code, WSL for dev, CUDA, Python/ML frameworks) being current and primary-supported on Windows. Community items are about telemetry/outages/account issues, not dev tooling currency, so they don't corroborate this axis either.
